fix: Replace both private bool fields with one layout enum: `#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)] enum EditorLayout { #[default] SingleLine, Multiline, Paragraphs }` and a field `#[builder(default, setter(skip))] layout: EditorLayout`. Use `layout != EditorLayout::SingleLine` where `multiline` is read, and `layout == EditorLayout::Paragraphs` where `paragraph_layout` is read. TextArea sets `Multiline`, DocumentEditor sets `Paragraphs`, so the single-line-with-paragraph-layout combination becomes unrepresentable.
